about: Questions a Khmer reader asks the assistant about a person or a place opened from the Reader's Names and Places panel (row menu → Open in Chatbot). Each scenario is one conversation, asked in order in one tab. `expect` is the grader's key, never sent: what a right answer says, and why. Run with scripts/lookup-run.mjs; first measured 2026-10-22.

asks.text: តើណូអេមានអាយុប៉ុន្មាននៅពេលគាត់ស្លាប់?
asks.expect: 950 years (Genesis 9:29; the record's age)

asks.text: តើណូអេមានអាយុប៉ុន្មាន ពេលទឹកជំនន់មកដល់?
asks.expect: 600 years (Genesis 7:6)

asks.text: តើណូអេមានកូនប៉ុន្មាននាក់?
asks.expect: three sons: Shem, Ham, Japheth (Genesis 5:32; 6:10). Sem is Luke 3:36's Greek spelling of Shem, not a fourth son

asks.text: តើជីតារបស់ណូអេជានរណា?
asks.expect: Methuselah, father of Lamech (Genesis 5:25-29)

asks.text: តើប្រពន្ធរបស់ណូអេឈ្មោះអ្វី?
asks.expect: the Bible does not give her name (Genesis 7:7 says only 'his wife')

asks.text: តើព្រះយេស៊ូវបាននិយាយអំពីណូអេដែរឬទេ?
asks.expect: yes: Matthew 24:37-39 and Luke 17:26-27 (KJV spells him Noe there)

asks.text: តើគម្ពីរសញ្ញាថ្មីនិយាយអំពីណូអេនៅកន្លែងណាខ្លះ?
asks.expect: Matthew 24:37-38, Luke 3:36, Luke 17:26-27, Hebrews 11:7, 1 Peter 3:20, 2 Peter 2:5

asks.text: តើឈ្មោះណូអេមានន័យដូចម្តេច?
asks.expect: rest / comfort: Genesis 5:29, 'this same shall comfort us'

asks.text: តើមានមនុស្សប៉ុន្មាននាក់នៅក្នុងទូកធំ?
asks.expect: eight (Genesis 7:13; 1 Peter 3:20)

asks.text: តើទូកធំបានចតនៅទីណា?
asks.expect: on the mountains of Ararat (Genesis 8:4)

asks.text: តើមានអ្នកណាផ្សេងទៀតក្នុងព្រះគម្ពីរដែលមានឈ្មោះណូអេ?
asks.expect: a daughter of Zelophehad (Numbers 26:33; 27:1; 36:11; Joshua 17:3)

asks.text: តើមធូសាឡាមានអាយុច្រើនជាងណូអេទេ?
asks.expect: yes: Methuselah 969 (Genesis 5:27), Noah 950 (Genesis 9:29)

asks.text: តើណូអេរស់នៅប៉ុន្មានឆ្នាំក្រោយទឹកជំនន់?
asks.expect: 350 years (Genesis 9:28)

asks.text: តើណូអេរស់នៅឆ្នាំណា?
asks.expect: the Bible gives no calendar year; it dates him by ages in the genealogy (Genesis 5, 7:6, 9:28-29)

asks.text: តើអារ៉ារ៉ាតនៅឯណា?
asks.expect: the Armenian highlands, the ancient kingdom of Urartu

asks.text: តើអារ៉ារ៉ាតសព្វថ្ងៃនៅប្រទេសណា?
asks.expect: eastern Turkey, Armenia and north-west Iran; Mount Ararat itself is in eastern Turkey

asks.text: តើអារ៉ារ៉ាតនៅឆ្ងាយពីក្រុងយេរូសាឡិមប៉ុន្មាន?
asks.expect: roughly 1,000-1,200 km to the north-east (an estimate, said as one)

asks.text: តើខគម្ពីរណាខ្លះនិយាយអំពីអារ៉ារ៉ាត?
asks.expect: Genesis 8:4, 2 Kings 19:37, Isaiah 37:38, Jeremiah 51:27 (the KJV says 'Armenia' in 2 Kings and Isaiah)

asks.text: តើអ្នកណាបានរត់ទៅស្រុកអារ៉ារ៉ាត?
asks.expect: Adrammelech and Sharezer, sons of Sennacherib, after killing their father (2 Kings 19:37; Isaiah 37:38)

asks.text: តើមានទីកន្លែងណាខ្លះនៅជិតអារ៉ារ៉ាត?
asks.expect: Minni and Ashchenaz with it in Jeremiah 51:27; Assyria to the south

asks.text: បង្ហាញអារ៉ារ៉ាតនៅលើផែនទី
asks.expect: a map the person can open, or an honest 'the record has no exact point' with where it is

asks.text: តើបេថ្លេហិមនៅឆ្ងាយពីក្រុងយេរូសាឡិមប៉ុន្មាន?
asks.expect: about 9 km (6 miles) south of Jerusalem

asks.text: តើនរណាខ្លះកើត ឬរស់នៅបេថ្លេហិម?
asks.expect: Jesus born there (Matthew 2:1); David's town (1 Samuel 16-17; Luke 2:4); Boaz, Naomi and Ruth (Ruth 1-4); Rachel buried on its way (Genesis 35:19)

asks.text: តើបេថ្លេហិមសព្វថ្ងៃនៅប្រទេសណា?
asks.expect: Bethlehem in the West Bank (Palestine), south of Jerusalem

asks.text: តើព្យាការីណាបានទាយថាព្រះមេស្ស៊ីនឹងកើតនៅបេថ្លេហិម?
asks.expect: Micah 5:2 (quoted in Matthew 2:5-6)
